definitions.line_id: GTFS route_id:direction_id:shape_id:SHA256(ordered stop_id|pickup_type|drop_off_type records separated by LF)[:16].
definitions.coordinates: WGS84 longitude, latitude in degrees rounded to six decimals. Full GTFS shape; short trips use a subsection.
definitions.stop_ids: Metro uses GTFS parent stations. Bus uses individual GTFS stops.
definitions.segment_minutes: Scheduled departure to next arrival for one trip template; excludes dwell. Choose lower median end-to-end elapsed time among trip records in this pattern, then lexically first tied trip_id. Each record counts once regardless of headway. Round to 0.001 min.
definitions.dwell_minutes: Departure minus arrival at each stop of the same representative trip, in minutes. Round to 0.001 min.
definitions.pickup_type/drop_off_type: Per-stop GTFS codes; 0 regular, 1 unavailable, 2 phone agency, 3 contact driver. These flags distinguish patterns.
definitions.headway_minutes: Reciprocal service density at the first stop on Monday 2026-04-13 during [08:00,09:00), after calendar exceptions. Divide 60 by fixed starts plus expected frequency starts (overlap seconds / headway seconds). Null when there are no starts. Round to 0.001 min. Do not infer a waiting time from this rate. For fixed trips use scheduled calls. For frequency trips use active windows.
definitions.timing_profiles: Each profile lists [arrival_offset_secs, departure_offset_secs] in stop order, relative to first-stop departure. Add fixed-trip departure time to reconstruct scheduled calls. For frequency trips shift the service window using the relevant call offsets.
definitions.trip_profile: GTFS trip_id to zero-based index in this pattern's timing_profiles. Includes each scheduled trip and frequency template.
definitions.service_time: America/Santiago GTFS service-day times; hours may exceed 23. Windows include start and exclude end. exact_times=0 gives approximate headways. Use calendar dates and exceptions.
definitions.coverage: GTFS route types 1 and 3. Published service; actual travel times and passenger counts unavailable in this feed.
